feedback: The confession follows the established flavoring comparison closely and explains precisely why Brie relocated individual preparation into the shared pitcher in her account. Opening the poison bottle during the closed preview is newly explicit, but the poison source, physical accessibility and split closure were already available, so it confirms the route rather than rescuing an unsolvable accusation. The clean retained ingredient container also receives a sensible explanation. Brie's staff trusting her gives the ending emotional consequence beyond a supplier bill and makes the confession stronger than the bare financial motive. Chip and Barb retain responsibility for their actual misconduct without implausibly becoming harmless. The finale is earned and clear, although the exact preview opening is necessarily confessed rather than independently witnessed.
